description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI' that handles API endpoints related to final evaluation of performance reviews within an HR management system. It includes methods for updating, retrieving, and validation of performance review final evaluations, implementing REST API behaviors with validation rules, transaction management, and role-based permission checks.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI
classes.description: A class handling API endpoints for final evaluation of performance reviews, including updating and retrieving review data, validation, and permission checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the API call to finalize and update a performance review's final evaluation, including transaction management and permission validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific performance review's final evaluation if accessible.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating delete operation is not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update endpoint request parameters and body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific review's data via GET.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws an exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: setFinalEvaluation
methods.description: Sets the final evaluation data on a PerformanceReview entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getFinalEvaluationBodyParamRules
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the request body parameters related to final evaluation, adjusting for whether the operation is a finalization or not.
